name: The Kelpfang
description: A living outrigger grown from Tamra-Blackwood and coral, built by the Tamra-Veil Wardens to find and seal the tears in reality that open over the southern magma rivers.
notes:
Its heart was a basalt Lingam stone carrying geothermal memory-seeds. Dismantled after the final voyage, its timbers becoming houses on the coast and its stones going to a lagoon hut.

This entry first said the Kelpfang was a whale-bone trawler captained by Varuna. That was wrong on both counts and came from an earlier document conflating this ship with the `place_leviathans_rib` of the Age of Machinery. The Kelpfang belongs to a spinoff with an entirely separate crew.
